replies.question: Can I use the template in Arabic?
replies.reply: The templates are designed to be bilingual, supporting both Arabic and English.

replies.question: I bought it twice by mistake, can I get my money back?
replies.reply: The founder will review each refund request manually and decide whether to approve it.

replies.question: Does it work on the Notion free plan?
replies.reply: The templates are compatible with Notion and should work on the free plan.
